headless-ci.description: Headless-safe CI lane: only checks that can execute without a local RenderingDevice.

release-ci.description: Canonical release-ready runtime validation profile: the non-headless GDScript runtime suite plus a required renderer proof. Wired as a nightly + workflow_dispatch evidence lane in .github/workflows/release_ci_runtime.yml on the self-hosted Windows GPU runner (GDScript tests only, --skip-cpp). NOT run by baseline QA CI, which runs headless-ci; the blocking streaming GPU gate is streaming-gpu-ci.

node-asset-gpu-ci.description: Focused GPU-backed proof that a canonical GaussianSplatNode3D renders a fixture GaussianSplatAsset and produces visual evidence. Not directly wired to a workflow; its Canonical Node Asset Render scenario is exercised nightly through the release-ci lane (release_ci_runtime.yml).

streaming-gpu-ci.description: Canonical blocking GPU-backed streaming validation gate for runtime residency and world-streaming regressions; benchmark proof surfaces live in the benchmark workflow.

stress-only.description: Stress-focused runtime lane for local and CI soak checks.

smoke.description: Fast local smoke profile for quick runtime sanity checks.
